item.title: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton warns Americans of 'bumps in the road' after tech outages
item.description: Clayton’s warning comes ahead of Thanksgiving travel, after separate outages disrupted air travel, Microsoft 365 and some bank transactions.

item.title: Pizza chains are under pressure. GLP-1 use is only one part of the problem
item.description: Domino's, Papa Johns and Pizza Hut face weaker demand, more delivery competition and changing eating habits, including GLP-1 use.

item.title: Quantum computing’s first real-world payoff may come in energy, not drug discovery
item.description: Quantum computing firms are testing energy-grid optimization, solar materials and hydrogen catalysts as they pursue practical uses.

item.title: Anthropic’s record IPO collides with tech’s worst week on Wall Street since 2020
item.description: Anthropic held its historic Nasdaq debut a day before Nvidia's stock closed out its longest weekly losing streak since 2008.
